detail.longDescription: Hi We’re writing to let you know about a recent security incident in which an attacker gained unauthorized access to our systems and retrieved information from some customers, including you. Protecting your information is our responsibility, and we fell short. We’re sorry for letting you down. Here’s what happened and what we’re doing about it. What happened On November 22, an attacker used a stolen credential for one of our development systems to gain access to other internal systems. On November 23, they gained access to our production systems and retrieved customer information. The information retrieved by the attacker included the email address, password hashes (not plaintext passwords), and the signup date associated with your account. What we’re doing Most importantly, we’ve reset the password for your account and signed you out of Todoist. We have also: Closed the gap the attacker used to get from one system to another. Checked our systems for any remaining unauthorized access and found none. Tightened access controls to limit the damage a stolen credential can cause. We know resetting your password is disruptive. It was the fastest way for us to act to keep your account safe. What you should do now Set a new password. Go to todoist.com, select Log in, then Forgot password or reset from this link. Your old password is already deactivated; this will allow you to set a new one. Change it anywhere else you’ve used it. If you’ve used the same or a similar password on other sites, update those too. Turn on two-factor authentication in Settings > Account > Password and security. Watch out for fake emails. Our notification about this incident comes from no-reply@notify.todoist.com. We will not ask you to send us your password or install software in response to this incident. If you’re unsure about a message, open todoist.com directly rather than following its links. If you’d like to read more details, you’ll find all the information in this article. Need help? We understand you may have questions. And if you do, please contact us here. Our team is on hand to help. Gonçalo Silva CTO of Todoist
